title: MIMO Independent Negative Control Audit
how_the_control_was_actually_performed: 1. Wipe target dir with _real_unlink/shutil.rmtree (L519-525) - the control STARTS from a dir it just destroyed.
4. time.sleep(5.0) with NO dispatch to Astra of any kind (L537-538).
6. Emit JSON: verdict = PASS iff file_count == 0 (L546-557).

audit_against_required_conditions.condition: Astra action dispatch was genuinely disabled
audit_against_required_conditions.finding: NOT TESTED. The control never attempts a dispatch - dispatch_enabled: false is a hardcoded literal (L551), not the outcome of disabling and challenging a dispatch path. No AstraRun instance was even required to be running for this control.

PARTIALLY. The observer process ran for 5 idle seconds and captured 2 frames - activity proven by code path, but the control's own frames/events were subsequently DESTROYED by the dogfood run's raw/ wipe (L587-591) minutes later, so no frozen evidence of that activity survives.

FALSE. No request is submitted during the negative control (by design: 'zero dispatch'). The control therefore does not exercise the write guard, the observer loop, or Astra's absence under equivalent load - it only proves the observer creates no files while doing absolutely nothing.
TRUE but vacuous: the control itself deleted everything seconds before snapshotting. A zero-file snapshot after self-wipe cannot distinguish 'observer created nothing' from 'wipe worked'.

MEASURED for files only: file_count == 0 after 5 idle seconds is a real measurement of the target dir. It does not cover docs/audit writes (observer writes there by design), screenshots, or any other path.
NOT MEASURED. windows_spawned_by_observer: 0 is a hardcoded literal (L554) - enumerate_desktop_windows() exists in the file but is never called in the control. No process snapshot is taken.

evidence_chain_defects: The control's raw frames and NEGATIVE_CONTROL_START event were written into raw/ then DELETED by the immediately following dogfood run's raw-wipe (timeline: NC ~20:45:29 -> dogfood capability-audit overwrite 20:45:35 -> baseline frame 20:45:36 -> freeze 20:46:10 -> evaluation 20:46:21).
F0_25E_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.json lives OUTSIDE raw/ and is NOT covered by F0_25E_RAW_MANIFEST.json - it was never cryptographically frozen.
The control is not exercised by tests/acceptance/test_f0_25e_acceptance_engine.py (0 of 8 tests cover run_negative_control).
Keyboard/mouse incapacity and write-guard effectiveness are never challenged during the control (guard installed but never attempted against).
verdict_rationale: Per review directive 6: where the control merely asserts values, classification is UNVERIFIED. Only one narrow fact is genuinely measured (no files in target dir after 5 idle seconds post self-wipe). Dispatch-disabled equivalence, zero windows, observer activity evidence, and zero application launches are literals or destroyed evidence. The control does not support the report's claim that observer non-causality was proven by it - that claim rests on the separate source-level audit (which MIMO independently confirms).
